༄༅/ /mthar thug dbu ma chen po 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i chos thams cad kyi gnad bstan bcos yid bzhin nor bu lta bu snying po nges pa zhes bya ba

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /mthar thug dbu ma chen po 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das

pa'i chos thams cad kyi gnad bstan bcos yid bzhin nor bu lta bu snying po nges pa zhes bya ba grub mtha'i mthar thugs bzhugs/ na mo gu ru buddha bo dhi satwa ārya ga ṇe bhyaḥ gdod ma'i sangs rgyas mchog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bde gshegs snying po de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /kun khyab chos sku de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nyid kyi bzhugs tshul rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi mkhyen pa'i dngos/ /brtse ldan dol po pa la gsol ba 'debs/ /yang cig gsol ba 'debs so nges don gyi/ /chos 'di srid gsum kun tu dar bar shog /klu rgyal rgya mtsho'i gting nas mtho ris 'dzegs/ /tshangs pa'i rnam 'phrul sa 'og bar du 'bab/ /bcom ldan sa steng bzhugs nas srid gsum khyab/ /rigs dang chos sku rang bzhin gsum gyi dpe/ /sangs rgyas rigs la de 'dras nyer btags pa/ /kun rdzob gzhi lam 'bras bu'i gnas thabs yin/ /chos dang chos nyid dbye ba mi 'byed par/ /sems sam sems can sangs rgyas rigs su 'dod/ /nges pa'i don du rigs mchog chos kyi dbyings/ /rnam shes brgyad po ye shes rnam bzhi dang*/ /chos dbyings dag pa gnyis ldan ye shes dang*/ /phung po lnga yang ye shes rnam lnga dang*/ /sngags kyi theg par de dag rigs lnga dang*/ /dbang po yul bcas sems dpa' yab yum dang*/ /'byung ba rnam lnga bcom ldan 'das ma dang*/ / lus ngag yid gsum sku gsung thugs gsum dang*/ /bzhi pa'i thig le ye shes rdo rje sogs/ /gnas gyur dbye ba rnam pa du ma dang*/ /sgrib bral dbye ba'ang ji snyed gsungs gyur pa/ /gnas gyur thams cad kun rdzob kho na'i yin/ /sgrib bral zhes pa gnyis ka'i phyogs la brten/ /dngos rgyun gcig la mtshan nyid ngan pa dor/ /bzang po'i gnas skabs 'dzin pa gnas gyur te/ /sra ba'i dngos po gcig la lcags kyi mdog /spangs nas gser du gyur pa lta bu yin/ /sgrib bral zhes pa dngos de ma 'gyur yang*/

/phyi rol sgrib byed glo bur spangs pa'i don/ /rang bzhin mi 'gyur don dam phyogs yin te/ /glo bur spangs pa kun rdzob phyogs la brten/ /gnas gyur la ni 'gyur bar byed po dang*/ /sgrib bral la yang bral byed lam yin te/ /de yang gzhi 'bras gnyis dang mthun pa zhig /bsgom na nges pa'i don gyi lam du 'gyur/ /mi rtag sdug bsngal tshad med bzhi la sogs/ /dmigs pa kun rdzob yin yang de kho na/ /cung zad yid la byed phyir 'dres mar yod/ /de bzhin bskyed rim phra thig las rgya sogs/ /phal cher mos pa yid byed drang don lam/ /'on kyang cha shas tsam gyis nges don 'dres/ /de phyir gnas lugs rtogs pa'i ring rgyu yin/ /rjes dpag rigs pas dpyad pa'i stong nyid dang*/ /kun rdzob rang sor 'jog pa'i rtog med kyang*/ /don spyi tsam dang dngos la dmigs pa'i phyir/ /nges don de nyid kho na yid byed min/ /rang bzhin bde gshegs snying po bsgom pa dang*/ khyad chos rgyal ba'i yon tan bsam pa gnyis/ /rnam rtog bral ba'i yid kyis 'go bsdus na/ /de ni nges don bde gshegs lam mchog yin/ /kun rdzob gzhi de 'bras bu'i kun rdzob dang*/ /'dra bar gnas pa'ang lam 'dis rgyas par byed/ /don dam la ni 'phel 'grib med mod kyi/ /sgrib g.yog bral bar byed pa'ang sgom 'di yin/ /gzhi dang 'bras bu 'dra chos yod pas na/ /gzhi la bcos na de rgyun 'bras bur 'gyur/ /gser phye mchod sdong rang bzhin 'dra ba la/ /bcos pas sngar gyis mchod sdong 'dra bar 'byung*/ /de bzhin rnam shes ye shes phyogs 'dra dang*/ /rnam shes thabs kyis bsgyur na sngar yod kyi/ /ye shes rnams dang 'dra bar 'gyur pa'i phyir/ /rigs zhes zer te kun rdzob kho na'i yin/ /nyer len rgyu dang rigs mthun 'dra chos rigs/ /de sgra phyogs mthun de yi rang bzhin dang*/ /de dang de dbyer med la rigs so zhes/

/'jog pa 'di ni don dam phyogs la 'o/ /don dam rigs ni skyed byed don min te/ /rgyu yi ming yang rang bzhin nyid la 'dogs/ /nye ring med pa'i dbyings de rgyu dang rigs/ /gcig nyid blo la 'dra bar snang ba yin/ /'jig rten na yang gcig la 'dra ba'i sgra/ /yod phyir tha snyad tshul dang 'gal ba min/ /'di rgyu gser las grub ces zer ba ltar/ /chos dbyings de ni rang bzhin phyir na rgyu/ /chu shing snying po med la 'bras snying dpe/ /thos dang zag med sa bon gsal stong rigs/ /de yi 'khor ba zad na mi slob lam/ /'di la'ang kun rdzob nyid las snying bor btags/ / zhes pa ni rigs kyi rnam par bzhag pa'o// //yang cig shes rab rgyal mtshan la phyag 'tshal/ /snying por sangs rgyas bzhugs tshul 'dir bshad bya/ /don dam snying po gtan la 'beb pa na/ /go bas blo yis rtogs tshul rnam pa gnyis/ bral 'bras chos sku 'bras bur smos ci dgos/ /lam dang 'khor ba'i chos la mar 'gebs dang*/ /gzhi yi chos nyid 'khor bar smos ci dgos/ /lam dang 'bras bu la yang yar snyog go /sangs rgyas ye shes sems can tshogs zhugs ni/ /tshangs pa'i sprul ba sa la 'bab pas mtshon/ /skabs 'dir don gyi gtso bo 'di yin te/ /bcom ldan shākya seng ge'i chos sku de/ /sangs rgyas yon tan kun gyi rgyan dang ldan/ /bdag gi lus ngag yid la de nyid khyab/ /lus ngag yid ni log snang 'khrul snang tsam/ /bag chags yid kyis 'khrul ba'i snang ba bskyed/ /sgyu ma'i rgyu las sgyu ma'i 'bras bu 'byung*/ /snang tshul kho na yin gyi gnas tshul min/ /bdag la khyab pa'i shāka thub chos sku de/ /'gro la snang tshul ma yin gnas tshul yin/ /bdag rang med pa'i gnas na de nyid yod/ /bdag ni 'khrul snang de ni ma 'khrul ba/ /bdag ni rdzun pa de ni bden par grub/ /bdag ni sdug bsngal de ni bde ba'i mchog /bdag ni mi rtag de ni rtag pa'i gtso/

/bdag ni kun btags de ni yongs grub yin/ / shāka thub chos sku de ni sangs rgyas dngos/ /sangs rgyas 'phrin las thams cad de yi yin/ /stobs bcu mi 'jigs la sogs lta ci smos/ /mtshan dpe la sogs yon tan kun dang ldan/ /de la sku yod gsung dang thugs kyang yod/ /sku gang yin pa gsung dang thugs kyang yin/ /bdag dang bdag la bzhugs pa'i shāka thub dang*/ /g.ya' dang gser gyi tshul du gnas pa yin/ /na bun ri bo'i dpe yis mtshon pa yin/ /de la sogs pa dpe ni mtha' yas yod/ /bdag la de 'dra'i shāka thub bzhugs pa de/ /bdag gis ma mthong grogs kyis mi mthong la/ /'khor ba'i sems can kun gyis mthong mi 'gyur/ /nyan thos sogs kyis dad pas rtogs bya tsam/ /sa bdun gnas pas kyang ni mngon sum min/ / mdzod nang nor bzhin phyogs 'go things pa tsam/ /dag sar gnas pas zur tsam 'ol spyi tsam/ /mtha' dag ma lus gzigs pa sangs rgyas nyid/ /chos sku de ni gdod nas spros dang bral/ /spros dang bral ngo shes pas bden par grub/ /ci yang min pa'i spros bral zhes bya ba/ /yid la byas na rtag tu spros pa yin/ /nam yang blos ma byas par grol 'gyur na/ /'khor ba snod bcud thams cad rang grol 'gyur/ /don spyi sgom pa thams cad rtog par zad/ /spros med dngos ni rang rig ye shes so/ /de ltar bdag la de bzhin gshegs pa ni/ /shākya thub pa mnyam par bzhag pa bzhugs/ /rnal 'byor mchog dang ldan pas sangs rgyas mthong*/ /'di thos rtog ge ba rnams khro zhing 'khrug /tshangs par gyur kyang chos spong las kyis bsregs/ /de bas grong ba'i skye bo phal ba rung*/ /ji ltar bdag la shākya'i rgyal po yi/ /ye shes sku de bzhugs pa ji bzhin du/ /pha ma phu nu 'khor g.yog kun la'ang yod/ /gnyen la de yod dgra la de yod de/ /lha dang dmyal ba dud 'gro kun la'ang yod/ /'gro drug sems can kun la'ang de 'dra bzhugs/

/byung dang 'byung 'gyur sems can thams cad la'ang*/ /lha mo sgyu 'phrul sras de rtag tu bzhugs/ /rnal 'byor can 'gas de dag so sor mthong*/ /sangs rgyas nyid kyis gzigs na thams cad gcig /bdag la bzhugs pa'i gau tam de kho na/ /sems can kun la khyab par bzhugs pa yin/ / gzhan la bzhugs pa'i bcom ldan bde gshegs las/ / gzhan pa bdag la'ang med de ngo bo gcig /chos sku shin tu rgya che sna tshogs 'di/ /de yi khongs su chud par gyur na yang*/ /chos rnams kun gyi nang na de mchog phyir/ /gtso dang gces pa'i don gyi snying po yin/ /shes bya kun la nye ring med phyir dang*/ /chos rnams thams cad gnas tshul gcig phyir dang*/ /sems las gzhan du phyi rol med phyir dang*/ /sems kyi chos nyid sems la khyab pa'i phyir/ /bdag la bzhugs pa'i nyi ma'i gnyen mchog de/ /brtan g.yo srid zhi kun la khyab pa yin/ /bgrod bya lam lnga sa bcu kun la khyab/ /bsgom bya byang phyogs phar phyin kun la khyab/ /phung po khams dang skye mched kun la khyab/ /rten 'brel bcu gnyis bden pa rnam bzhi dang*/ /rags dang phra ba mtshan mtshon gzhi gsum sogs/ /kun gyi srog dang dwangs mar 'di nyid bzhugs/ /shākya'i rigs kyi thig le'i chos sku de/ /bcom ldan 'od srung chos sku'ang de kho na/ /rnam gzigs mar me mdzad kyi'ang de kho na/ /'das pa'i sangs rgyas kun gyi chos sku de/ / bcom ldan shākya thub pa'i chos sku yin/ /bde gshegs gau tam chen po'i chos sku las/ /'das pa'i sangs rgyas chos sku gzhan yod min/ /'od dpag med dang mi 'khrugs la sogs pa/ /da lta'i sangs rgyas kun gyi chos sku dang*/ /byams pa snang mdzad la sogs ma 'ongs pa'i/ /rgyal ba kun gyi chos sku'ang de dang 'dra/ / kun rdzob sangs rgyas dus gsum byung ba rnams/ /lam bden nyid yin de dag thams cad kyi/ /spyi nor don dam chos kyi sku yin pas/ /chos sku gnyis su med de kun la khyab/

/chos sku 'di ni 'das pa'i dus tshad yod/ /'das pa'i sangs rgyas kun gyis 'di mngon mdzad/ /'das pa'i dus kyis 'di la ma gos pas/ / da ltar phyi ma'i dus la 'di nyid gnas/ /'das dus bzhin du dus gnyis po la'ang sbyar/ /dus tshad kun na yod kyang dus spangs pa/ /da lta'i sangs rgyas kun gyis 'di rtogs shing*/ /ma byon sangs rgyas kun gyis shāka thub kyi/ /chos sku 'di nyid mngon du mdzad 'gyur gyi/ /chos sku gzhan zhig mngon du 'gyur ba min/ /dus la ji bzhin phyogs la'ang sbyar bya ste/ /yul tshad kun la yod kyang yul dang bral/ /sangs rgyas skyes bu ji snyed thams cad kyi/ /spyi nor yin pas shākya seng ge'i yang*/ /yin phyir shāka thub chos sku zhes su grags/ /de bzhin sangs rgyas kun la'ang bsgre bar bya/ /spyi nor de ni brtan thub nor gyi mchog / sgos nor lam bden chos rnams ya ma brla/ /de phyir shes bya kun gyi gnas tshul ni/ /shāka thub yin te 'od srung sogs kyang yin/ /sangs rgyas gcig kyang yin la kun kyang yin/ /chos rnams kun gyi gnas tshul sangs rgyas yin/ /de nigatsang bde rtag bdag pha rol phyin/ /'bras bu'i sangs rgyas zer yang gnas lugs yin/ /snod bcud 'khor 'das rten 'brel chos rnams kun/ /rang tshugs mi thub bdag med snang tshul tsam/ /sangs rgyas de yi 'od kyis dge blo 'byung/ /dge ba rgyas pas 'khrul snang rang sar sangs/ /de tshe sangs rgyas skyes bu chos skur reg /de la snang tshul gnas tshul tha dad med/ /rang snang dang po grol lam khyad par bcas/ /de rjes chos sku'i ngo bor de nyid thim/ /de nas gzhan snang gzugs sku rtag tu 'byung*/ /gzugs sku gnyis dang lam bden gyis bsdus pa'i/ /bde gshegs de ni sangs rgyas tsam po ba/ /sangs rgyas dngos rang de ni chos sku'o/ /zhes pa ni sangs rgyas nyid snying por rnam par bzhag pa'o// da dung kun mkhyen che la gsol ba 'debs/

/blo yi rtogs tshul gnyis pa 'di ltar go /rang bzhin dri med de ni gnyis med de/ /bcom ldan sa steng bzhugs pa'i dpe dang 'dra/ /bum pa'i rang bzhin chos nyid ces bya ba/ /gdod nas gzung 'dzin gnyis bral ye shes te/ /de ni don dam de ni stong nyid dang*/ /de ni brjod bral de ni spros bral dang*/ /de ni mtha' bral rang bzhin sher phyin no/ /de nyid rtag chad mtha' las gdod nas 'das/ /yod mtha' med mtha' yin min mtha' dang bral/ /rgyu 'bras ma yin gcig min du ma min/ / yul dang yul can dbye ba 'di la med/ /rtogs bya rtogs byed rim pa kun bral yang*/ /ci med cang med ci yang ma yin tsam/ /gang du'ang mi gnas tsam gyi stong nyid min/ /de 'dra yin na dngos med tsam du 'gyur/ /de yang 'dod na mngon sum rtogs mi srid/ /rtog pas rtogs na spros pa'i tha shal yin/ /ma rtogs par 'dod 'bad pa don med 'gyur/ /de phyir 'di ni spros kun gyis dben pa'i/ /rang rig rang gsal gdod ma gcig tu yod/ /de yi khyad par rnam pa thams cad pa/ /srid 'das kun gyi rnam pa yod tshad du/ /gdod nas rtag tu gcig char shar bzhin pa/ /shar yang de rnams kun gyis ma gos pa/ /gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya'i yul spangs kyang*/ /ye shes gzugs sogs kun tu yod yod pa/ /mig sogs dbang bo'i lus ni spangs gyur kyang*/ /don dam mig sogs kun tu gnas gnas pa/ /tshogs brgyad sems byung rnam rtog kun bral yang*/ /chos nyid rig pa mtha' yas shar shar ba/ /de sogs shes bya kun la sbyar bar bya/ /rnam pa kun ldan rnam pa med par dgongs/ /phyogs kyis ma gos dus kyis ma gos kyang*/ /phyogs dus kun gyi rnam pa 'char ba'i phyir/ /dus gsum dus med rtogs pa'i ye shes so/ /dus rnams kun tu byung yang rtag pa dang*/ /rnam pa kun tu byung yang spros bral ba/ /'di ni bsam gyis mi khyab mtshan nyid de/

/'phags mchog rnams kyis mngon sum nyid du gzigs/ /rgya bod yul gyi skal chad thos rlom can/ /thams cad 'di thos tsam na snying khrag bskam/ /de phyir ri chos gsang ba zab mo yin/ /srid tshad kun gyi rnam par gnas pa'i phyir/ /skyob pa kun gyi yon tan 'di la yod/ /'di nyid bde gshegs chos sku dngos nyid yin/ /bde gshegs snying po yon tan can zhes bya/ /bum pa'i dngos la bde gshegs snying po bzhugs/ /gnas tshul chos nyid de yin bum pa min/ /bum pa zhes bya nam yang yod ma myong*/ /bum par snang ba de ni 'khrul snang tsam/ /de yi shul na gnyis med ye shes yod/ /de ni rtag brtan zhi ba g.yung drung nyid/ /bum pa'i chos dbyings de ltar yin pa bzhin/ /ka ba sogs kyi dbyings kyang de dang 'dra/ /de yi rigs pas 'byung ba 'byung gyur dang*/ /gtso bo rnam shes 'khor dang bcas pa dang*/ /yul dus skye 'gag la sogs chos kun gyi/ /rang bzhin gnas lugs bde bar gshegs pa yin/ /de ltar yin na sems can thams cad kyi/ /gnas lugs bde gshegs yin pa smos ci dgos/ /gnas lugs gzung 'dzin gnyis bral ye shes kyi/ /cha nas 'phags mchog kun gyis gcig tu gzigs/ /de nyid yon tan can gyi snying po ru/ /gzigs pa rnams la'ang so sor snang ba yod/ /sgrib kun bral na tha dad snang ba med/ /so sor snang ba thams cad 'khrul ba ste/ /shes bya'i sgrib pa yin pas de zad na/ /rang snang nyid la chos sku las gzhan med/ /sangs rgyas ye shes kho na'i spyod yul na/ /sangs rgyas las gzhan snang ba cung zad med/ /de nyid phyin ci ma log rang snang ste/ /chos sku las gzhan gang mthong log snang yin/ /bdag gzhan 'khor ba'i chos nyid gang yin pa/ /nges par yod kyang mthong ba ma yin pas/ /sbas pa'i tshul du 'dug phyir snying por 'dod/ /de ni sems can rnams kyis rgyu mtshan la/ /brten nas snying por 'jog tshul gcig yin no/

/chos nyid dge ba yin pas dge sems 'byung*/ /lam rnams 'di las byung zhing 'di yis khyab/ /shes bya kun gyi chos kyi dbyings 'di la/ /rtogs pa po ni sangs rgyas kho na'i phyir/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi chos skur mtshan yang gsol/ /dam pa'i don gyi sems can sangs rgyas gcig /lus ngag yid gsum 'dus pa'i phung po ni/ /brda tsam dbang gis kun rdzob sems can te/ /skyes bur 'jog pa kun rdzob sgo nas brjod/ /chos can ming gis sbyor na kun rdzob gtso/ /sangs rgyas sogs la don dam gtso bor rig /rdzogs sangs rgyas la kun rdzob mi snang yang*/ /rnam pa thams cad nyid kyis ji snyed mkhyen/ /'khor 'das de bzhin nyid dbyer med ces pa/ /phan tshun 'dra ba tsam la 'jog pa 'khrul/ /dngos med yin na ldog rkyang tsam du zad/ /de la tha dad 'dra mtshan ji bzhin med/ /gal te dngos yin ngo bo tha dad na/ /rnam pa kun tu 'dra ba srid ma yin/ /ji ltar sngar bzhin phyis kyang de nyid 'di/ /mi rtag du ma nyid la shin tu 'gal/ /dri bcas 'khor ba la 'brel zhi la med/ /dri med srid la nam yang ma 'brel na/ /snga ma ji bzhin phyi ma gang na ci/ /dri bcas dri med dngos tha dad phyir ro/ /skad cig yin na dus tshod so sor 'brel/ /so so la yang rang ngo tha dad phyir/ /phan tshun mtshan nyid mi 'dra du mas gos/ /phan tshun ji bzhin 'dra zhes zer ba blun/ khyad par mi 'dra ci yang mi srid na/ /de ni ngo bo gcig pa'i dan rtags yin/ /'dra bzhin mnyam mtshungs thal ches gcig tu go /chos dbyings gdod nas dri med dri bral yin/ /de bzhin nyid la dri bcas nam yang med/ /sems can la bltos dri bcas rnam bzhag tsam/ /dag pa gnyis ldan zhes byar don la med/ /sangs rgyas skyes bu'i ngos nas bzhag pa tsam/ /chos kyi dbyings la 'khor 'das yod min pas/ /dri mas bcing dang gsar du grol ba med/ /'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa'i chos kun la/

/chos sku 'di ni mgon du yod pa'i phyir/ /brtags ngor de bzhin nyid la gnyis so zhes/ /dpyad pa med pa'i tshul du 'jog pa yin/ /ngo bo gcig dang tha dad las grol kyang*/ /du mar med phyir gcig gi ming 'jug pa/ /de bzhin nyid de shes bya kun la khyab/ /kun gyi spyi la bzhugs pa nyid kyi phyir/ /lha mi dud 'gro ri dang thang la sogs/ /so so tha dad bye brag snang grags pa/ /re re kun gyi'ang de bzhin nyid du 'gyur/ /'on kyang so sor med de spyi la khebs/ /rtag nyid phyir na dus gsum kun khyab cing*/ /cha med nyid phyir yul kun gcig car khyab/ / sangs rgyas rnams kyi de bzhin nyid gang yin/ /sems can kun gyi'ang de bzhin nyid du yod/ /de phyir sems can snying po can du gsungs/ /dngos kyi sangs rgyas de bzhin nyid phyir ro/ /de bzhin nyid de 'gyur med rtag pa'i phyir/ /mngon du gyur ram ma gyur gang yin yang*/ /snying po nyid de sra ba'i don phyir ro/ /zhes pa ni de bzhin nyid rnam par gzhag pa'o// //slar yang rton pa bzhi ldan la phyag 'tshal/ /rigs nyid phyir na rigs de 'phel ba'i phyir/ /drang don thabs kyi lam la 'jug kyang dgos/ /spyod pa rnam par dag pa'i sgo yang de/ /sangs rgyas khyab pa'i phyir na rjes dran sgoms/ /yon tan mtha' yas de las mos pa skye/ /'khor 'das kun la de bzhin nyid gcig pas//dmigs pa tha dad med de chos dbyings nyid/ /chos la mos pas sangs rgyas rjes dran bsgom/ /de yang snying por yon tan nges pa yin/ /chos nyid yul du byed pa shes rab dang*/ /de bsgom mnyam gzhag rjes thob gnyis su dbye/ /mnyam gzhag zhi gnas lhag mthong zung du 'jug /zhi lhag gnyis kar rtog bral ma 'khrul ba/ /rgyu 'bras theg pa'i sgo nas dbye ba yod/ /rjes thob rang bzhin snang ba'i dbye ba shes/ /kun rdzob sgyu ma lta bu gtso bor sgoms/ / shes rab bsam gtan zhes bya de la 'dus/

/mnyam gzhag rjes thob gnyis kar snying rje che/ /phal cher de yi spyod pa rjes thob na'o/ /'di la rnam kun rdzogs pa'i sgrub pa dang*/ /cha shas tsam la dpyad kyang don ldan 'gyur/ /rtsa ba'i tshul khrims byang sdom spyod la gnas/ /thub pa'i bstan la so sor thar pa bzhi/ / de yang de yi sngon 'gro rten du 'gyur/ /gal te gsang ba'i theg pa la mos na/ / dam tshig gis ni de nyid mchog tu byed/ /rgyal ba'i gsung la yid ches mos ldan pas/ /sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa rgyun mi 'chad/ /rjes dran gzhan dag de yi rjes 'gro nyid/ /chos nyid don la rnam par mi rtog pa'o/ /gal te mtshan mar 'dzin na gnyen po bsten/ /snang bar bcas dang snang ba med par spyod/ /'gro kun bde gshegs snying po can yin pas/ /gang zag med cing phung sogs chos med kyang*/ /bdag mtshungs byams dang snying rje phyogs med sgoms/ /ji srid 'byung ba yod cing rnam rtog yod/ /de srid brtson 'grus drag pos dge la sbyor/ /de nyid gzhan gyi don du byang chub bsngo/ /ring por mi thogs bzod pa thob par 'gyur/ /bsam gtan mchog bzhi rim dang gcig car 'grub/ /rang ngam gzhan la sangs rgyas rtag bzhugs na/ /de mi bzhugs par lta ba log lta yin/ /thogs med spyan ldan sangs rgyas drung 'dug kyang*/ /rang gis ma mthong bag med spyod dang mtshungs/ /'gro kun bde gshegs snying po can yin na/ / snying po med snyam skur 'debs chad par lta/ /sems can rgyu yi rigs la dmigs pa dang*/ /'bras bus sangs rgyas chos la dmigs nas skur/ /rgyu 'bras gnyis ka'i phyogs la skur pa btab/ /dngos la yod kyang med par lta ba ni/ /bden gnyis gnas skabs gang du'ang skur 'debs nyid/ /'gro ba'i rang bzhin sangs rgyas min snyam pa/ /rgyal la rnam mkhyen med par smra dang mtshungs/ /rtag pa 'jig par smra ba chad lta ste/ /cho 'phrul che tshe mu stegs ston pa drug

/gau tam me yis tshig ces zer dang mtshungs/ /sangs rgyas rtag pa la dang sems can rnams/ /snying po can du smra la skur 'debs pa/ /de dag phal cher mi bzad dmyal bar 'gro/ /'jim gzugs tsam la'ang co 'dri skur 'debs pa/ /de yang ngan 'gror 'gyur na 'dir ci smos/ /sangs rgyas la dmigs 'jig dang sdug bsngal zer/ /rgyu mthun 'bras bu tshe thung ba dang nad/ /de bas sdig lta mi bzad spangs byas nas/ /bde gshegs snying po dad pas rtogs par bya/ /gal te zab mo'i don la mos shing sgoms/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba smin na gcig car rtogs/ /gzhan du rnam kun spyod pas rim gyis 'thob/ /cha shas kyis kyang don chen 'gyur ba ste/ /sngon du mtshams med byas pa'ang 'di yis grol/ /sdig la spyod bzhin pa yang 'dir dad na/ /rnam smin ring du skrod cing zad par byed/ /bag med sred pa'i dbang gyur yul lnga la/ / rtag tu bsten pa'ang mi 'ching grol ba yod/ /brtul zhugs nyams pa'ang lha yul 'gro ba dang*/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi sku yi snang ba 'byung*/ /'di la dad pa'i yon tan bsam mi khyab/ /sman dang sngags kyi sbyor ba 'ga' yis kyang*/ /lan rer sdig can mtho ris gnas 'gro srid/ /rgyal ba'i yon tan bsam yas la mos na/ /phan yon de dag ci phyir 'byung mi 'gyur/ /kun mkhyen mchog de'i bzhed dgongs 'khrul med 'di/ /gzhan gyis ji bzhin smra ba ma byung ngo*/ /rig 'dzin theg par sku gsung thugs rdo rje/ /'phrin las rnams kyi rnam pa mtha' yas sgoms/ /snang med tsam zhig chos sku yin gyur na/ /de kun log pas rnam par brtags par 'gyur/ /bcos ma'i rim pas gzugs sku lam du byed/ / 'on kyang ji bzhin ma yin rjes mthun tsam/ /grub pa'i rim pas sku gsung thugs rnam pa/ /'di dag gtso bor chos sku lam du byed/ /las dang pos kyang snying po cung zad mthong*/ /gsang sngags thun mong min pa'i thabs las so/

/ las rlung rnam rtog gcig tu 'jug pa ni/ /ji ltar rigs par 'gog pa thabs kyi mchog /rtogs dang rtsol ba'i gzhan dbang dang bral ba/ /snang brnyan sgra dbyangs bde stong chos skur mtshungs/ de phyir chos sku lam du byed par nus/ / 'ga' zhig don dam chos sku'i snang ba nyid/ /kha cig nyams snang yin yang de yi lam/ /mnyam gzhag de dang rdo rje slob dpon mchog /mchod cing mnyes pas tshogs gnyis rab rdzogs nas/ /gdod ma'i rdo rje bzhi po mngon du 'gyur/ / sangs rgyas skyes bu gcig gis chos dbyings rtogs/ /de rgyu nyid las sems can mtha' yas la/ /gang 'dul 'phrin las mkha' khyab rtag tu 'jug /nyi dang 'od zer bzhin du lhun gyis grub/ /ces pa ni nges par 'byung ba dang 'byin pa gtan la dbab pa'o// //da ltar sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes nyid//shes bya kun la khyab cing bzhugs pa'i phyir/ /de nyidachos dbyings yin te bdag la sogs/ /srog ldan kun la'ang mgon dang bcud du bzhugs/ /de ni spros bral yin phyir rgyu 'bras min/ /'on kyang de yod na ni 'khor 'das 'byung*/ /med na min pas kun gzhi ye shes zer/ /de 'dra'i nye ba'i mdangs 'od lam yin te/ /de yang 'khor ba'i chos dang 'dzom las 'byung*/ /de lta na yang de yis 'khor ba spong*/ /gang zag 'khrul pa zad na de sangs rgya/ /'khrul spangs gang zag nyid kyang spang gyur mod/ /snga ma'i shugs las gnas gyur ye shes 'byung*/ /de ni sangs rgyas skyes bu zhes su brjod/ /rig pa lam gzhan 'dres shing dbyings ni gcig / tshigs bcad 'di bzhi po la don kun tshang*/ /gzhan smra'i rjes su skyor zlos ma byas par/ /'chad tshul go bde sngon med smra bar spobs/ /nges pa'i don gyi gsang ba zab mo 'di/ /gsal zhing ma sbas gol sa chod par smras/ /go ba'i dus na ma 'thor gcig tu 'gril/ /smra ba'i dus na ngag don khar longs shing*/ /'bel gtam byed na klan ka'i gnas med pa/

/ji bzhin smra ba 'di yang mgon gyi mthu/ /lta ba'i phyogs la mang du bshad zin mod/ kha chem snying la zhen pa 'di las med/ /spros pa'i chos skad rnam pa sna tshogs rnams/ /lung rigs gnyis dang mthun na gang dgar gyis/ /'di med bshad rlabs bzang yang khog stong yin/ /phyag rgya 'dis btab kun kyang bdud rtsi nyid/ /'dir bshad 'di la dge ba mchis so cog /jo bo sems can don gyi mchog tu bsngo/ /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i chos thams cad kyi gnad sngon med pa'i bstan bcos yid bzhin nor bu lta bu snying po nges pa zhes bya ba 'di ni/ rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa rnams kyi thugs rjes mtshams sbyar bas/ dol po sangs rgyas de'i byin rlabs snying la zhugs te/ rgyal ba rgyal sras thams cad kyi dgongs pa'i gnad phyin ci ma log pa la nges pa rnyed nas/ kha ba can gyi shambha lar thun gcig la nges par brjod pa'o/ /'dir smras pa/ da ni lang tsho yol gyur pas/ /mang du smras pas ci zhig bya/ /gces pa'i snying 'di phyung gyur kyang*/ /sha dum cir mi rung du zad/ /bcom ldan de la yid ches pas/ /bdag ni srog dang snying dang tshe/ /kun las gces pa gsang ba'i tshig /'di las gzhan du smra rgyu med/ /mkhas sam shin tu blun yang rung*/ /nus pa ldan nam mi ldan rung*/ /spyod pa bzang ngam ngan yang rung*/ /'di bzhin 'bad na don chen thob/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i shes rab yod rlom dang*/ /zhib tig ngom pa'i mgo 'khregs tshul 'chos dang*/ /rtsing chos phaṭa ral grub par bkur ba yang*/ /zab mo 'di ma rtogs pas g.yang sar lhung*/ /grub mtha' 'di ni mdo rgyud kun gyi don/ /'chad tshul 'di 'dra bdag gi blo la shar/ /'phags mchog kun gyi dgongs pa'ang 'di yin la/ /sngon med legs brjod ces kyang 'gal ba med/ /rgyal ba kun gyi bgrod pa gcig gyur/ /shes bya gshis kyi gnas lugs 'khrul med/ /snying gtam 'di ni de ring bshad do/

/blo sna ma mang rtse gcig sgrubs shig /gcig zhus/ maṅga laṃ/ bla ma'i zhal lung rgyal kun thugs kyi gsang*/ /'dir 'bad dge las skye ba thams cad du/ /'di nyid thos shing 'di don nyams su myong*/ /'di nyid rtogs nas kun kyang 'dir 'jug shog /shu bhaṃ mastu sarba dzā ga taṃ/ yang zhus//
mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/mtha' thug dbu ma chen po'i gnad bstan bcos yid bzhin nor bu lta bu snying po nges pa bzhugs/ - PAGE 100 -- PAGE 101 -- PAGE 85 -
